title: Extend Pro 4 to 5.x
summary: The dialog behind the new-major notice's Extend Pro 4 to 5.x…: Pro 4's line widens from 4.x to 4.x and 5.x, so its 64 licenses get DJDL 5 at no charge, starting with 5.0.0-beta.1 on the beta track. It names the licenses, the build and the stored range, and says what narrowing it later would do.
compare: Opens over the Licenses page from the notice's Extend Pro 4 to 5.x… (and the same button in Pro 4's record); focus starts on Cancel, because the change gives every holder a free major.
The first sentence names who gets what and when: Pro 4's 64 licenses, 5.0.0-beta.1 at the next update check (Pro 4 includes the beta track), 5.0.0 when it reaches stable, at no charge.

The summary shows the change as before → after (Versions: 4.x → 4.x and 5.x) and the license count; the note gives the stored range in mono (4.0.0 to 5.999999.999999) and says that narrowing it back later stops updates for devices already on 5.x.
A line points to Start a 5.x tier… for charging for DJDL 5 instead.

The primary says exactly what happens: 'Give 64 licenses 5.x'. After it, Pro 4's Versions read '4.x and 5.x · from Duration', a toast says 'Pro 4 now covers 5.x', and the notice is gone from Licenses and from Pro 4's record.
The page behind keeps New license as its one primary; the notice's actions are outline buttons and a ghost Dismiss.
Phone: the dialog takes the full width; the summary keeps two columns; Cancel and Give 64 licenses 5.x share the foot.
